1.0.56.en: Force charge reliably kicks Easee when idle-ready (pulse current); sequential force + Easee sync.
1.0.56.da: Tvungen opladning vækker Easee når laderen står klar men idle (strømpuls); force og Easee kører i rækkefølge.

1.0.55.en: Easee start when charge_now is true even if the charger looked idle; tile power reflects real Easee state.
1.0.55.da: Easee startes ved charge_now også når laderen stod klar men ikke ladede; flisens effekt viser reel Easee-status.

1.0.54.en: Charge hours needed (and one-shot hours) use 30-minute steps on the device tile and in planning.
1.0.54.da: Ladetimer behov (og engangs-timer) kan sættes i 30-minutters trin på enheden og i planen.

1.0.53.en: Charge window times (day/night start and end) can be set in 30-minute steps in app settings.
1.0.53.da: Ladevinduer (dag/nat start og slut) kan sættes i 30-minutters trin i app-indstillinger.

1.0.52.en: Force charge works any time of day (overrides spot/night plan); still auto-stops at 16:59 before tariff rise.
1.0.52.da: Tvungen opladning virker døgnet rundt (overruler spot/natteplan); stopper stadig automatisk kl. 16:59 før takststigning.

1.0.51.en: Fixed day-end charge stop at 16:59 (before tariff rise at 17:00), independent of app day-end setting.
1.0.51.da: Fast stop af opladning kl. 16:59 (før takststigning kl. 17), uafhængigt af dag-slut i indstillinger.

1.0.50.en: Day-end stop triggers at 16:59 (one minute before configured day end).
1.0.50.da: Dag-slut stop kl. 16:59 (ét minut før konfigureret dag-slut).

1.0.49.en: Day-end watchdog only stops charging at 17:00 — no plan re-evaluation.
1.0.49.da: Dag-slut watchdog stopper kun opladning kl. 17 — ingen plan-genberegning.

1.0.48.en: Day-end watchdog: evaluate every minute from 16:55 to 17:05 to stop charging at day end.
1.0.48.da: Dag-slut watchdog: genberegner hvert minut 16:55-17:05 for at stoppe opladning ved dag-slut.

1.0.47.en: Force charge only during the day window; auto-off and stop charging after day end (17:00).
1.0.47.da: Tvungen opladning kun i dagvinduet; slås fra og stopper opladning efter dag-slut (17:00).

1.0.46.en: Refresh charge_message on every device and app settings change.
1.0.46.da: Opdater charge_message ved alle enheds- og app-indstillingsændringer.

1.0.45.en: Evening plan message (flows + charge_message) uses same format as push notifications.
1.0.45.da: Aftenplan-besked (flows + charge_message) bruger samme format som push-notifikationer.

1.0.44.en: Night end slider on device tile (half hours 04:00-10:00). Plan notifications show times only.
1.0.44.da: Nat-sluttid på flisen (halve timer 04:00-10:00). Plan-notifikationer viser kun klokkeslæt.

1.0.43.en: Plan notifications: Dagsplan/Natteplan lines with schedule and window hours, no dates.
1.0.43.da: Plan-notifikationer: Dagsplan/Natteplan med plan og vindue-tider, uden dato.

1.0.42.en: Simpler plan notifications: plans only with mode line (cheapest vs spot threshold).
1.0.42.da: Enklere plan-notifikationer: kun planer med modus (billigste vs spot-grænse).

1.0.41.en: Cleaner plan push notifications with line breaks; day and night plans; no dishwasher hint.
1.0.41.da: Renere plan-notifikationer med linjeskift; dag- og natplan; uden opvask-hint.

1.0.40.en: Push notification with updated charge plan when toggling night charge, cheapest-only, and one-shot.
1.0.40.da: Push-notifikation med ny ladeplan ved skift af natteopladning, kun-billigste-plan og engangsopladning.

1.0.39.en: Trailing settlement poll for Easee power: every 5s up to 60s, extend 10s on change until stable.
1.0.39.da: Trailing poll af Easee-effekt: hvert 5s i op til 60s, +10s ved ændring indtil stabil.

1.0.38.en: Sync measure_power from Easee with fallback estimate while ramping; poll faster when charging.
1.0.38.da: Synkroniser measure_power fra Easee med estimat under opstart; hurtigere polling ved opladning.

1.0.37.en: Force charge toggle returns immediately; Easee and full plan evaluation run in background.
1.0.37.da: Tvungen opladning svarer med det samme; Easee og fuld evaluering kører i baggrunden.

1.0.36.en: Force charge now overrides night-disabled and day-window limits; skip Logic overwrite on toggle.
1.0.36.da: Tvungen opladning ignorerer nu natte-deaktivering og dagvindue; Logic ikke læst ved toggle.

1.0.35.en: Fix force charge during day plan; reduce Easee API calls with caching, retries on rate limit, and sync only when state differs.
1.0.35.da: Ret tvungen dagopladning; færre Easee API-kald med cache, retry ved rate limit, og sync kun når tilstand afviger.

1.0.34.en: Push notification with new charge plan when charge hours are changed.
1.0.34.da: Push-notifikation med ny ladeplan når ladetimer ændres.

1.0.33.en: Fix charge schedule not updating when charge hours change; read hours from capability and queue overlapping evaluations.
1.0.33.da: Ret at ladeplan ikke opdateres ved ændring af ladetimer; læser timer fra capability og kører udsatte evalueringer.

1.0.32.en: Fix cheapest-plan-only being reset each evaluation; charge schedule shows total span from first to last selected slot.
1.0.32.da: Ret at kun-billigste-plan blev nulstillet ved hver evaluering; ladeplan viser samlet tidsspænd fra første til sidste valgte kvarter.

1.0.31.en: Removed Home Assistant webhook integration; app focuses on spot prices and direct Easee control only.
1.0.31.da: Fjernet Home Assistant webhook — appen fokuserer kun på spotpriser og direkte Easee-styring.

1.0.30.en: Integrated Easee start/stop and Home Assistant EV webhook on charge_now changes, replacing the 15-minute Logic Flow.
1.0.30.da: Integreret Easee start/stop og Home Assistant EV-webhook ved charge_now-skift, så det gamle 15-minutters Logic-Flow kan slås fra.

1.0.29.en: Add per-device spot threshold slider and cheapest-plan-only toggle (default: spot charging under threshold).
1.0.29.da: Tilføj spot-grænse slider og toggle for kun billigste plan (standard: spot-opladning under grænsen).

1.0.28.en: charge_now is only true during planned charge slots, not whenever spot is below the threshold.
1.0.28.da: charge_now er kun true i planlagte ladekvarter, ikke bare fordi spotprisen er under graensen.

1.0.27.en: Spot price tile now uses Stromligning live 15-minute prices instead of repeating the hourly value four times.
1.0.27.da: Spotpris-flisen bruger nu Stromlignings live 15-minutters priser i stedet for at gentage timeprisen fire gange.

1.0.17.en: Fix Logic mirroring by preferring homey.logic and logging sync failures instead of failing silently.
1.0.17.da: Ret Logic-spejling ved at foretraekke homey.logic og logge sync-fejl i stedet for at fejle stille.

1.0.16.en: Fix device Unavailable state: keep device available after evaluation errors and close pair sessions properly.
1.0.16.da: Ret Unavailable-tilstand: enheden forbliver tilgængelig ved evalueringsfejl, og pair sessions lukkes korrekt.

1.0.15.en: Fix Logic variable mirroring via Manager API so charge_now and other variables stay in sync with the device.
1.0.15.da: Ret Logic-variabel spejling via Manager API, så charge_now og andre variabler følger enheden.

1.0.14.en: Night charging toggle, reliable 15-minute scheduler with quarter-hour alignment, and device UI sliders/toggles.
1.0.14.da: Natteopladning-toggle, pålidelig 15-minutters scheduler med kvarters-justering, og device UI med sliders/toggles.

1.0.13.en: Add configurable day/night charge windows, pairing guide in settings, and driver pairing fixes.
1.0.13.da: Tilføj konfigurerbare dag/nat-ladevinduer, pairing-vejledning i indstillinger og driver-rettelser.

1.0.2.en: Auto-create EV Ladeplan device on startup; add create-device button in settings.
1.0.2.da: Auto-opret EV Ladeplan-enhed ved opstart; tilføj knap i indstillinger.

1.0.3.en: EV charger tile: power toggle, measure_power status (W), and evcharger class.
1.0.3.da: EV-lader flise: power-knap, measure_power status (W), og evcharger-klasse.

1.0.6.en: Fix device.js syntax error and improve EV Ladeplan device discovery/provisioning.
1.0.6.da: Ret syntaxfejl i device.js og forbedret EV Ladeplan device-discovery/provisioning.

1.0.5.en: Direct Easee charger control from charge_now, with optional real power sync to the planner tile.
1.0.5.da: Direkte Easee-styring fra charge_now, med valgfri synkronisering af rigtig effekt til ladeplan-flisen.

1.0.4.en: Fix one-shot charge: freeze plan for single run, reset Logic variable, and fix false 11 kW display.
1.0.4.da: Ret engangsopladning: fast plan kun én gang, nulstil Logic-variabel, og ret forkert 11 kW visning.
